newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's PPWK to pay 1996 dividend.
newsitem.headline: Poland's PPWK to pay 1996 dividend.

text.p: Polish map publisher PPWK SA will likely pay a dividend for 1996, as it has in previous years, the company's president Alina Meljon said on Tuesday.
"Shareholders can expect that as in past years a dividend will be paid for 1996," Meljon told reporters.
Last year PPWK paid a dividend of 0.5 zlotys per share after netting 3.1 million zlotys on sales of 20.1 million.

Meljon said the company was likely to exceed this year's net profit and sales forecasts of 4.4 million and 24.7 million zlotys respectively after its 35-percent sales increase in November compared with the same month last year.
She said PPWK sales growth next year should be the same as the annual inflation rate. The government sees annual inflation at 13 percent next year.
